proposed_widenings.name: form-gated magic-item component condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can already change form with alter_item_kind, but passive and activated mechanics cannot currently be gated on the item's current form. Existing predicates only cover armor/weapon equipment states, not item-mode state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "In certain forms, the weapon has the following additional properties."

proposed_widenings.name: triggering-attack-scoped modify_ac reaction rider
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can express a reaction trigger and modify_ac, but not a +5 AC bonus that applies only against the triggering attack and then ends immediately.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "...gaining a +5 bonus to your Armor Class against the triggering attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you."

proposed_widenings.name: return-thrown-weapon-to-wielder
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface has no honest way to represent a weapon that gains Thrown ranges and then automatically returns to the wielder immediately after the ranged attack resolves.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. The +2 attack and damage bonuses fit today, and the dim-light rider can be treated as caller-owned per existing repo practice, but the form-dependent mechanics and returning-thrown behavior do not.
